text: Free demo, and it's the sequel to Hellcard, from the Book of Demons studio.
The whole dungeon is made of paper, and it pops up out of a book.
You and your friends fight back-to-back in the middle of a circle of monsters.
Everything you do is a card. Attack, block, burn.
Between fights you get little story rooms. A campfire, a cracked eggshell, a sarcophagus you probably shouldn't open.
The catch? The trailer barely shows the combat. About five seconds of it.
The demo is nearly five gigs, in thirteen languages, and the full game is due in twenty twenty-seven.
Think Slay the Spire, with friends and a lot of dragons.
Worth a dip if paper monsters are your thing.
